messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#98765 — us-west-3 / AZ3 — model-serving high 5xx rate and request timeouts. auto-escalate after 3m.

pagerduty: Incident triggered: https://pagerduty.example/PD-98765 — assigned to on-call: Jamie Lee.

Jamie Lee: Acked. I'm on it. Observed spike in 5xx across model-serving pods in az3. Confirming customer impact now.

Arjun Patel: seeing KV cache evictions and repeated OOMs in logs for shard-scaler. Pulling logs.

Eve (SRE): @Jamie can you hold PD escalate? I'll triage node health first.

Jamie Lee: sure. Eve — do you have node metrics? CPU/GPU pressure?

Eve (SRE): GPU util ~98% on az3-gpu-pool, mem pressure ~92%. Pod restart count increasing. Looks like heavy prefix-cache thrash + model kernel OOMs.

Lina Gomez: customer impact: error spikes on hosted API for some tenants — a subset of requests failing with 502/504. Product Ops wants an initial status for comms.

Jamie Lee: initial impact: partial API degradation for us-west-3 (AZ3). Not global. Some customers on dedicated pools unaffected.

Arjun Patel: running quick kubectl:

```
kubectl get pods -n model-serving -o wide --selector=zone=az3
NAME                                    READY   STATUS      RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
model-svc-aaa-0                         0/1     CrashLoop   6          2h    ip-10-0-3-12
model-svc-bbb-1                         1/1     Running     0          6h    ip-10-0-3-13
model-svc-ccc-2                         0/1     OOMKilled   3          3h    ip-10-0-3-14
```

Arjun Patel: logs show repeated kernel OOMs from custom kernel-fusion op. Possibly regression from recent runtime patch rolled to az3 last night.

Jamie Lee: rollback candidate? Which revision deployed to az3?

Eve (SRE): revision r2026.4 pushed 02:12 UTC. Canary looked fine but load there is heavier. I'm rolling back to r2026.3 on az3 now.

incident-bot: Rollback job started by Eve (SRE) — job-id rb-441234. Notifying autoscaler.

Lina Gomez: Product Ops: drafting short customer update: "We are investigating increased error rates in US-WEST-3 (AZ3). Some requests may experience errors; teams are working on mitigation. Will follow up in 30 minutes."

Jamie Lee: Also enabling routing fallback to az1 for traffic eligible for cross-az reroutes. Triggering routing policy change now (graceful diversion, 10% -> 100%).

Arjun Patel: applying routing change:

```
redwood-router set-route --src-region us-west-3 --failover-region us-west-1 --policy gradual --window 15m
```

incident-bot: Routing change applied: gradual diversion started.

Eve (SRE): rollback succeeded on most pods, kernel OOMs stop in logs, restarting CrashLoop pods. Confirming GPU mem patterns normalizing.

Jamie Lee: Good. Continue monitoring. Lina please prepare a follow-up status that includes mitigation steps taken and ETA.

Lina Gomez: On it. Draft: "Mitigation: rollback to prior runtime revision completed; traffic diverted to us-west-1; we've restarted affected pods. Impact narrowed to AZ3; degradations subsiding. ETA for full recovery: 45–60m. We'll update if anything changes"

Product Ops Bot: Suggested recipients list: affected customers, account owners for tiered customers, status page update.

Jamie Lee: Also need a timeline for full validation of inference quality — backups may have used fallback model variant that has slightly different outputs. Flagging ML team.

Arjun Patel: Confirmed fallback used model-variant: quantized-v2 for diverted traffic. Latency improved but QA shows minor response differences for a small prompt set. Logging for quality regression.

Eve (SRE): Autoscaler adjustments: increased min-replicas in az1 & az3 fallback pools to prevent immediate re-eviction.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: escalation scheduled in 25m if incident not resolved.

Jamie Lee: Handoff plan: I'll stay for next 20m, then hand to Arjun for deeper root-cause and follow-up with runtime team. If anyone else wants to take continuity, speak up now.

Arjun Patel: I can take the handoff. I'll keep PD ack and monitor logs for any regression.

Lina Gomez: I'll publish status page update now and DM affected account managers with the draft.

Eve (SRE): Quick checklist I'm doing:
- node drain + reprovision of 2 noisy nodes in az3
- ensure kernel-fusion op rolled back globally in az3
- review crashloop traces for memory leak pattern
- monitor KV cache evictions for 30m

Jamie Lee: Thanks. If rollback doesn't hold or OOMs resume, we'll consider temporary capacity boost (burst dedicated) and full region failover.

incident-bot: Update logged at 4412345890: rollback completed; routing diversion at 60% now.

Arjun Patel: Observability: error rate dropped from 18% -> 4% over past 8m. Latency tail improved. Continuing monitoring.

Lina Gomez: Status page updated. Message posted to affected customers.

Jamie Lee: Great. I'll hand over in 15m. Arjun, take PD assignment at 4412346789 (handoff TS).

pagerduty: On-call reassignment: PD-98765 -> Arjun Patel (ack required).

Arjun Patel: Acked on PD. I have the thread. Will escalate to runtime team if OOM signatures reappear.

Eve (SRE): Follow-up tasks for post-incident:
- full postmortem with timeline and root cause (rollback released to canary without full load test)
- add proactive load test for kernel-fusion op in canary pools
- update automated routing policy to detect regression patterns by op-level OOM metric

Lina Gomez: Will prepare customer post-incident note once we have RC and mitigation details.

Jamie Lee: Locking this thread for now; will re-open if we see new spikes. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD-98765 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will auto-resolve after 2h if stable.
